name: nation_allegiance
title: Dated nation allegiance in a conflict (data/nation_allegiance.csv)
description: Hand-maintained. One row per period in which a nation (a code of data/nationalities.csv) stood on one side of a conflict: Allied, Axis, neutral, co-belligerent or non-aligned-belligerent. A nation has several rows when its side changed (Italy, the United States). Rows of one nation and one conflict never overlap; a gap between two rows means the table states nothing for those days (no source read, or no status such as Italy between the armistice of 8 September 1943 and 13 October 1943). Added 15 November 2026. It replaced the single `alliance` column of data/nationalities.csv, retired on 15 November 2026 (roadmap 384, part 3).

fields.name: nation
fields.description: The `code` of a row of data/nationalities.csv (not the multinational `ALL`).

fields.name: side
fields.description: The side the nation was on during the period.

fields.name: valid_from
fields.description: First day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD, not before the start of the conflict.

fields.name: valid_to
fields.description: Last day of the period (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD, not before valid_from. Blank = still open (none yet). For the nation's last row it is the end of the conflict for that nation as the sources date it, not a change of side.

fields.name: conflict
fields.description: The conflict the row belongs to.

fields.name: reference_ids
fields.description: ';'-separated reference ids of data/references_meta.csv; at least one.

fields.name: note
fields.description: What the source says (paraphrased); where a date is the start of the table rather than an event, or is uncertain, the note says so.
